recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: every line of htop suddenly worth decoding
webb telescope puzzling over a stranger early universe
the air in the room named the real bottleneck
Fourth of July fireworks silenced by coastal heat
summer wedding bells over Manhattan rooftops
Peru still counting votes weeks after election day

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch stutter-house beat fragments drifting through grey fog on a San Francisco rooftop before they dissolve into static.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap left/right to jump between three lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each 45-second loop assembles one complete micro-drop with a satisfying final hit
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters accelerate, fog thickens, fragments shrink and split into pairs
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe pulses in overcast grey mist

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Conduct a canceled Fourth of July fireworks show from your phone — tap to launch shells on beat drops while a heat wave builds pressure.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on descending beat markers, hold for sustained shells
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nail one chorus sync for a perfect 30-second finale burst
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: syncopation shifts mid-round, double-taps and off-beat fakes appear
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout silhouettes against orange heat haze

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick constellation shards into Webb telescope mirror segments before cosmic drift scatters them — each round captures one early-universe snapshot.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag and release to flick pieces into curved mirror slots
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: slot the final shard to reveal a complete galaxy image
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more fragments spawn, gravity wells weaken, drift speed increases
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: deep indigo watercolor with gold dust particles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort rogue htop process bars into cool and hot bins before room temperature overheats the machine — the air itself is the enemy.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag process bars into temperature bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clear one overheating spike and watch the fan meter drop
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more processes spawn, heat threshold tightens, decoy bars mimic real spikes
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: monospace terminal green on black with rising heat shimmer
